title: 否定与更正表达
goal: 辨认否定范围与更正后保留的信息。

points.label: 确定否定表达作用的范围
听出更正后保留的信息

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 长对话材料的教学依据

body.p: 否定表达说明动作在什么时间、多大程度上没有发生。更正表达把前面的说法换成另一个说法，事实以更正后的为准。

body.box:
A: Has the parcel arrived? B: Not yet.
A: Is the meeting on Monday? B: Actually, it's on Tuesday.

body.p: Not yet 表示包裹现在还没到。actually 后面把开会的日子改成了周二。否定和更正针对哪件事，看前后相邻的话。

cards.title: 否定的时间与范围
rows: A: Is the gate open? B: Not yet; it opens at nine.
A: Did the parcel arrive? B: Not yet; it's still in transit.
过去如此，现在已不再如此
A: Does the bus stop here? B: No longer; it stops across the road.
A: Is the shop open on Sundays? B: No longer; it's closed that day.
A: Is there much milk? B: Hardly any; the bottle is almost empty.
A: Does Sam use the car? B: Hardly ever; Sam usually cycles.
A: When does the hall open? B: Not until ten; it's closed before then.
指定条件满足后才发生
A: When can we leave? B: Not until the rain stops.
cards.note: hardly any 是很少，还剩一点。not yet 只说到现在为止还没有，以后的结果没有说。

cards.title: 更正后的信息
rows: A: The class starts at two. B: Actually, it starts at three.
A: The keys are on the desk. B: Actually, they're in the drawer.
以一项安排替代另一项
A: Shall we take the bus? B: Let's walk instead.
A: Use the red box? B: Use the blue one instead.
A: Meet on Tuesday, I mean Wednesday. B: Wednesday is fine.
A: Bring four, I mean five cups. B: I'll bring five.

body.box:
A: Has the report been sent?
B: Not yet. I planned to send it to Mira today, but actually it needs her manager's approval first. I'll send it to the manager instead.
A: Then Mira will receive it after approval.
B: Yes. The manager asked to see the figures.
A: Are the figures in the final section?
B: Yes, and the table is complete.
A: I'll keep a copy for our records.
B: I'll attach the table before sending it.

Who will receive the report first?
1. Mira's manager
2. Mira herself
3. The speaker who keeps a copy
4. Mira and her manager at once

body.p: Not yet 说明报告还没发。I'll send it to the manager instead 把收件人改成了经理，即第一项。第二项是更正前的安排。

lines.text: Has the paint dried?
Not yet. It still feels wet.

items.stem: What is the current state of the paint?
options: It has dried completely.
It is still wet to the touch.
It will dry before noon.
It was already dry yesterday.
items.why: Not yet 和 still feels wet 表明油漆尚未干，即第二项。

lines.text: Does the cafe still serve lunch?
No longer. It only serves breakfast now.

items.stem: What can be inferred about the cafe now?
options: It serves both lunch and breakfast.
It serves lunch but not breakfast.
It has not opened for breakfast yet.
It serves breakfast but not lunch.
items.why: 依据是 No longer 和 It only serves breakfast now，现在只供应早餐，不再供应午餐，即第四项。

lines.text: The film begins at seven, doesn't it?
Actually, it begins at eight.

options: At eight o'clock
At seven o'clock
An hour before seven
Between seven and eight
items.why: Actually 后面的 it begins at eight 更正了时间，即第一项。第二项是更正前的说法。

lines.text: Should I take the green folder?
Please take the yellow one instead.

items.stem: Which folder should the first speaker take?
options: The folder with a green cover
Both the yellow and green folders
The folder with a yellow cover
Neither of the two colored folders
items.why: The yellow one instead 用黄色文件夹替代绿色文件夹，即第三项。

lines.text: Are the chairs ready for the reading?
Not yet. The hall doesn't open until ten.
We have hardly any time before the event at eleven.
The chairs are already in the hall, so arranging them won't take long.
Good. I'll bring the signs at half past nine.
Put them by the door, please.
Do we need signs for the north entrance?
Actually, use the south entrance. The north one is closed.

items.stem: When will the hall become available?
options: Before half past nine
At ten in the morning
At eleven in the morning
After the reading has ended
items.why: The hall doesn't open until ten 表示十点才开放，即第二项。

items.stem: Which entrance should the signs refer to?
options: The entrance on the north side
Both entrances to the hall
The entrance on the south side
Neither entrance to the hall
items.why: Actually, use the south entrance 更正了入口，即第三项。

lines.text: Has the library received the new maps?
Not yet. The parcel is still at the post office.

items.stem: What is the status of the maps?
options: They are still waiting at the post office.
They are already at the library.
The library has sent them to the post office.
They will arrive at the library today.
items.why: 依据是 Not yet 和 The parcel is still at the post office，地图还在邮局，即第一项。

lines.text: Does the ferry stop at the island every day?
No longer. It now stops there only on weekends.

items.stem: What is true of the ferry's current schedule?
options: It stops on weekdays only.
It stops at the island every day.
It stops at the island on weekends only.
It no longer stops at the island at all.
items.why: No longer 和 only on weekends 表明现在只在周末停靠，即第三项。

lines.text: Is there enough flour for the bread?
Hardly any is left. We need to buy more.

options: Enough for several loaves
Only a very small amount
Exactly enough for one loaf
No flour at all
items.why: Hardly any is left 表示面粉只剩很少，即第二项。第四项把 hardly any 当成了一点都没有。

lines.text: Can we enter the exhibition at nine?
Not until ten. The staff need an hour to prepare.

items.stem: When can visitors enter the exhibition?
options: Before the staff arrive at nine
At nine when preparation starts
During the hour of preparation
At ten after the preparation
items.why: Not until ten 表明十点才可入场，即第四项。

lines.text: The parcel should go to the west office.
Actually, it should go to the east office.

items.stem: Where should the parcel be sent?
options: To both offices in the building
To the office on the east side
To the office on the west side
To neither office in the building
items.why: Actually 后的 east office 更正了接收地点，即第二项。

lines.text: Shall we make tea for the guests?
Let's offer them coffee instead.

items.stem: What do the speakers plan to offer?
options: Both tea and coffee to the guests
Tea before the guests have coffee
Tea instead of coffee for the guests
Coffee in place of tea for the guests
items.why: Offer them coffee instead 用咖啡替代茶，即第四项。

lines.text: Please bring six plates, I mean seven plates.
All right, I'll bring them.

options: Seven plates for the occasion
Six plates for the occasion
One plate in addition to seven
Thirteen plates altogether
items.why: I mean seven plates 把数量更正为七个，即第一项。

lines.text: Let's meet on Thursday, I mean Friday.
Friday works for me.

options: Thursday before the meeting
Both Thursday and Friday
Friday rather than Thursday
The day after Friday
items.why: I mean Friday 把日期改为周五，即第三项。
